detail.name: 32 Day Notice Account
detail.description: If you need more frequent access to your savings, our notice account features a competitive interest rate, that is calculated on the daily closing credit balance of your account and paid monthly, and gives you access to your money after providing 32 days’ notice. A good choice for you if you are saving for a goal such as a deposit on a house, new car or holiday, you would like to make regular deposits to your savings, and if you prefer a variable interest rate.

features.additionalInfo: A savings account with funds available with 32 days prior notice
Competitive interest rate on credit balances and no monthly account keeping fees
Add funds to account at any time
Interest calculated daily and paid monthly
No minimum balance requirements
Keep track of your investment by using online or mobile banking to keep tabs on your earnings.

constraints.additionalInfo: While we have the discretion to determine deposit size, we usually accept a minimum deposit of  AUD 10,000.00
